privileged_info_for_vlm: The correct coordinates for Cusco are 13.53° S (-13.53) and 71.97° W (-71.97). For the date June 21, 1450, Stellarium uses the Julian Calendar (Julian Date approx 2250841.625). The 'Inca' sky culture must be active to see the 'Llama' (Yacana) dark constellation. The Milky Way intensity setting is found in the 'Sky' tab of the 'Sky and viewing options' [F4] window. Alpha Centauri (Rigil Kentaurus) serves as the 'eyes' of the Llama.
